text:
```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  detect-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Detect potential duplicates
        id: potential-duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          threshold: 90
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: |
            Potential duplicate found:
            ${{ steps.potential-duplicates.outputs.similar_issues }}
```
